responseBoundaryLifecycleSecurity.lifecycleOwner: Dynamics Web API connector 在單一 request scope 內讀取、驗證、投影與釋放每一頁的 response stream、buffer、HttpResponseMessage、continuation 與取消資源；OperationResponseData 只保存已複製的純值，絕不延長 transport 資源生命週期。
responseBoundaryLifecycleSecurity.securityBoundary: 產品邊界只允許 operationId、ceVersion、responseKind 與已登錄的 WhoAmI、feeRecords 或 storLessonRecords；禁止 JsonElement、object、OData annotation、CRM hostname/API root、nextLink、credential、token、session 或 upstream extension data。
responseBoundaryLifecycleSecurity.rollbackAndFeatureGate: 任何未知 response kind、錯配 branch、超過 page/byte 政策或未投影 metadata 都必須在下一次 credential-bearing request 前失敗關閉；Package01FeeReadsEnabled 維持 false，契約存在不代表允許產品流量。

solutionTopology.optionalSeparateSolutionPolicy: A separate SpeechMessage.Dynamics.sln or solution filter is optional only after the Dynamics project group is registered in SpeechMessageProducts.sln; it cannot become a second project-reference source of truth.

enforcement.promotionRule: Promote a source root from report-only only after every current Organization call site in that root has a normalized row and the generated OperationDefinition registry agreement check passes.
